headline: How Welltower’s Q2 Beat, Guidance Trim and 221st Dividend Will Impact Welltower (WELL) Investors
summary: Welltower Inc. has reported second-quarter 2026 results, with revenue of US$3.54 billion and net income of US$445 million, raised earnings above analyst expectations, slightly lowered full-year net income guidance, and declared its 221st consecutive quarterly cash dividend of US$0.85 per share, paid on August 20, 2026. The combination of stronger-than-expected quarterly performance and a long-running dividend record highlights how Welltower is pairing operational momentum with ongoing cash...
